notes: NOCTURNE FIELD: a seeded, real-time evolving generative artwork in one self-contained HTML file, no external assets. Deterministic sfc32 PRNG + integer-hashed curl-noise flow, fixed timestep; seed in URL hash (#seed=...&t=...), reproducible. Four crossfaded movements. WebGL2 GLSL rendering with procedural FBM backdrop, ordered dithering, vignette, grain; Canvas2D fallback. Optional WebAudio synthesized soundscape (generated reverb, no assets). Fullscreen, high-resolution PNG export, adaptive resolution targeting 60 FPS, minimal fading UI, keyboard + touch, prefers-reduced-motion, tab-visibility handling, guarded storage. Tested in a current evergreen browser via Playwright: no console errors, interactions, sound toggle, PNG export, keyboard and reduced-motion verified, and seed determinism unit-checked. Known limitation: perfect pixel-identical reproduction assumes no viewer interaction, default speed, same viewport/aspect and reduced-motion setting; audio is not seeded.
